svg.title: AI Analytics Data Platform — Databricks V2 architecture
svg.desc: A detailed white-background architecture showing the scheduled Databricks Lakeflow medallion pipeline, governed Unity Catalog schemas, and the separate user-triggered DataOps Agent workflow with four read-only tools, LangGraph, bounded Genie investigations, managed stores, and evidence-linked recommendations.
svg.text: AI Analytics Data Platform — Databricks V2
Scheduled lakehouse processing → governed operational evidence → user-triggered DataOps investigation
Daily end-to-end orchestration · scheduled 2:00 AM America/Los_Angeles
Lakeflow advances the synthetic logical day and executes the dbt warehouse stages
Jobs execution metadata + governed observability checks · successful execution ≠ every health check passed · pipeline ↔ monitoring association remains UNVERIFIED
Manual Refresh is lightweight; Run Full Investigation is one explicit user action
NO SCHEDULED AI · NO EMAIL · NO AUTOMATIC REPAIR

g.text: READ-ONLY TOOL BELT · four independent capabilities
No arbitrary SQL · job control · writes · repairs · backfills
No execute, repair, schedule, or email action

svg.text: Run Full Investigation · direct fixed workflow
Governance, compute, deployment, and managed application state

g.text: Centralized access boundaries · lineage · analytics/PII isolation
Known span-upload networking limitation documented separately.
